text:
After lunch, pet arrivals stood out in your note, and we are sorry that your companion animal travel experience did not meet the standard Aurelia Skyways promises. You reported that the delayed departure disrupted your plans, left you uncertain about support, and created avoidable stress for both you and your pet. We treat that concern seriously because the Companion Animal Travel Desk is meant to give clear guidance, steady handling, and prompt follow-through from booking through arrival.

<<FACT F109>>

Our review is focused on the service gap you experienced, not on shifting responsibility. The senior coordinator has asked for a direct review of the handling notes, the communication trail, and the pet handoff process so we can identify where the breakdown occurred. The safety coordinator is also examining whether any preventable issue affected the companion animal flow at the airport and whether our staff applied the correct escalation steps. That review is important, because travelers with pets should not have to chase answers when they are already managing a difficult trip.

We understand that a delayed departure can affect feeding, exercise, medication timing, and the overall well-being of a pet. If the travel record shows that additional support was needed, we will address that through the proper service channel and make sure the case is closed with clear communication. Our team will also use your complaint to reinforce reminders on calm handling, timely updates, and careful coordination with ground staff so a similar lapse is less likely to recur.

Please accept our apology for the disruption and the extra burden it caused. We value the trust you placed in Aurelia Skyways, and we intend to respond with both accountability and practical correction. Companion Animal Travel Desk
